title: Signed Hamming two-tail function
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real threshold $t$, and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, let $H_{t,n}$ denote the Hamming upper-tail indicator on the sign cube. The signed two-tail function is $H_{t,n}(x)-H_{t,n}(-x)$, where $-x$ is the coordinatewise negation of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
caveat: The payload does not define the Hamming upper-tail indicator, so its precise threshold convention cannot be stated.
